summary: Comprehensive FinPlanner backend E2E testing executed. 30/30 pytest cases PASSED covering auth (public currencies, 401 scoping, invalid session, seeded token, personal workspace), workspaces (create shared seeds categories, add member, unknown workspace returns 404), accounts (bank/cash/credit_card with balances, soft-delete), categories CRUD, transactions (income/expense/refund/transfer balance math verified exactly, cross-currency USD->INR base_amount=830, sort desc, soft-delete), shared household split expense + dashboard portfolio analytics (paid/allocated per member), credit cards (statement_balance, unbilled, minimum_due, revolving_estimate, due_date, available_credit, payment reduces outstanding), budgets (idempotent per category, computed spent, delete), recurring (CRUD + dashboard upcoming), fixed deposits (maturity_value & accrued_interest), stocks (invested/current_value/pnl), dashboard required fields, audit log present for shared and empty for personal, export snapshot, CSV import (imported count, zero-amount skipped), premium toggle. Account-deletion endpoint (DELETE /api/users/me) was intentionally NOT exercised to preserve the seeded Bearer token for subsequent iterations.

minor.endpoint: GET /api/accounts (and other scoped endpoints) with foreign workspace_id
minor.issue: True 403 non-member scoping could not be independently verified without a second real user; verified 404 for unknown workspace_id. The code path (require_workspace) does enforce 403 by inspecting ws.members.user_id, so logically covered.

The type-coercion fallback has a confusing conditional (`raw_amt.startswith('-') is False and row.get('type') == 'income'`) that will almost always evaluate to expense when type is missing — may silently misclassify rows. Report for review, not a test blocker.
Payment is accepted even when from_account_id is None (stores transfer with account_id=None). Consider validating from_account_id is required.

action_items: (Optional) Harden CSV import type inference to default to 'expense' explicitly and avoid confusing boolean logic in server.py:521.
No functional backend bugs blocking frontend work — proceed with frontend implementation/testing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~900 lines — within reasonable limits but approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, workspaces, accounts, transactions, planner, dashboard) in future iterations.
All MongoDB queries correctly exclude _id and use custom string ids — compliant.
Env vars used correctly (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME); no hardcoded values.
Startup indexes created on users.email, user_sessions.session_token (unique) and TTL on expires_at — good.
FX conversion is static (planner-grade) as per PRD; USD=83 verified.
seed_data_creation: Ran python /app/backend/seed_test.py once at start. The seeded Bearer token (test_token_finplanner_e2e) and workspace (ws_test_fin_personal) remain valid. Each shared-workspace test created a TEST_Household workspace that is soft-deleted at teardown. Account-deletion test was intentionally skipped to keep the token alive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Seed token is still valid. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_finplanner_e2e.py can be re-run as regression. If running DELETE /api/users/me in future, re-run `python /app/backend/seed_test.py` immediately afterward. Frontend testing was NOT performed in this iteration (backend only).
